purpose: Pre-specified reliability enhancement and external validation; no CNN retraining; no test-label model selection.

selection_rules.feature_head: hyperparameters chosen by patient-grouped CV on training embeddings only
selection_rules.fusion_weight: chosen from fixed grid on validation data; outer test labels never used
selection_rules.enhancement_guard: enhanced predictor activated only when pre-specified validation macro-F1 gain is met
selection_rules.ood_method: chosen using held-out DermNet validation categories; reported OOD performance uses disjoint DermNet test categories
selection_rules.external: MSID excluded from all tuning; duplicate/near-duplicate filtering is applied before evaluation
